title: Cut the Communication contract to five load-bearing rules plus one worked example
action: routing-and-contracts.md lines ~157-346 hold ~30 prose rules no hook can check. Keep five: pre-send check (first+last line answer what happened / what is next), one question per message, a red or refusal line is never silenced, evidence beside fresh output, work-language with its two exemptions. Fold the rest (vague-duration ban, tangent-once, ids-never-lead, purpose-first, the 5-step answer order, plain-language bullets) into one short style paragraph plus one good/bad example pair. Keep the Question Format template and the File Quick Reference. Do not touch headings other files point at without repointing them.

truths: the cut rules survive as one example, not a list
